Out of sight, out of mind.

You had a goal last month. Do you remember what it was?

Probably not. Because somewhere between Slack notifications and that urgent thing from Tuesday, it slipped off your radar. Not because you gave up. Because it got buried.

The important stuff is usually hard and slow. So when your day fills up with smaller things that feel productive, the big stuff quietly disappears.

And the more things you try to juggle, the faster they all blur together. Nothing feels clear anymore. So you just react to whatever shows up next.

Clarity Keeps the Important Stuff Visible

You write down the few things that actually matter. They stay in front of you every day. When you sit down to work, you already know what to do.

How It Works

One Page. Everything That Matters.

Your Today page shows what to work on, your progress, and your activity. All in one place, nothing buried.

Not Everything Works the Same Way

Different goals need different cards. Pick the one that fits.
